Shared synthetic credential constant for the in-process scripted SMB test peer; its key derivation checks test NTLM proofs/signatures. The entire module is excluded from normal builds by its cfg(test) declaration. This specific finding is not reachable in a non-test build. CodeQL reports either of two representative paths for this finding on an unchanged tree: through src/smb/conn.rs test logins, or through the src/smb/client.rs test pool (pool_at(.., as_user(PASSWORD))). Both were reviewed; every sink on both is inside a #[cfg(test)] module. Later runs reported a third and a fourth representative path (the fourth through the src/smb/conn.rs test module and the scripted peer's own key derivation); their sinks are the same #[cfg(test)] modules and both were reviewed. The fourth path is also reported with its two flows in the opposite order, which digests differently; it is the same reviewed path.
